See what OLBG's tipsters are backing in today's matches with our free Rugby Union betting tips and predictions. Browse match winner and handicap selections from the Premiership, United Rugby Championship, Top 14, Pro D2, European Champions Cup, Super Rugby and Currie Cup, plus ante-post picks for major tournaments, including the Six Nations and, closer to the event, the Rugby World Cup.

Alongside our Rugby Union tips, OLBG provides best bets and predictions across more than 20 sports. The most popular selections of the day are on our betting tips page, and you can find Rugby League tips too. To see how the leading competitions compare, jump to our Rugby Union betting stats.
About Our Rugby Union Betting Tips and Predictions

This page brings together OLBG's Rugby Union tips and predictions for today's and upcoming matches, along with ante-post picks for the major tournaments. Our tipsters post match winner and handicap selections and explain their reasoning in their comments, so you can judge each tip for yourself.

Rugby Union Competitions Our Tipsters Cover

Our tipsters post Rugby Union betting tips for the leading club competitions, including the Premiership, United Rugby Championship, Top 14, Pro D2, Super Rugby Pacific, Currie Cup, European Champions Cup and European Challenge Cup. On the international scene, you'll find Six Nations tips, with Rugby World Cup predictions added as the tournament approaches. Season-long and ante-post best bets are included where our tipsters have them.

How to Read the Rugby Union Tips Table

Each row in the table above covers one selection. These are the columns:

ColumnWhat it shows
EventsThe match or tournament the tip is for.
SelectionThe tip itself, such as a team to win or a handicap line.
OddsThe bookmaker odds for that selection.
Tips & CommentsThe share of tips placed on the selection within that market, plus the tipsters' comments explaining their picks.
Value RatingA comparison of the selection's odds with its theoretical probability of winning, based on the percentage of tips for it.
AddAdds the selection to your betslip.

You can re-order the Rugby Union predictions to suit you by using the sort arrows in the column headings, for example by event, by odds, by the most popular tip or by value rating.

Once you've chosen your selections, compare bookmakers' odds before you place your bet. Please gamble responsibly and only bet what you can afford to lose, as no tip is guaranteed to win. You must be 18 or over to bet, and free, confidential support is available from GamCare and BeGambleAware.
How to Choose Rugby Union Tips to Back

Every Rugby Union tip on this page comes from an OLBG tipster and is recorded, so you can judge a prediction on its merits before you back it. Read the comments alongside each selection to see the reasoning behind the tip, then decide whether you agree with it.

The tips table gives you more to go on. The percentage of tips on a selection shows how much support it has among our tipsters, and the value rating compares the odds with that level of support to highlight potential value. Look out for tips from our Experts too: these are OLBG tipsters with high strike rates, or strong current-month or six-month profit, in Rugby Union.

If you would rather start with the tipsters themselves, our Best Rugby Union Tipsters page ranks them by profit and strike rate, with their available tips alongside. Their stats are tracked over twelve months.
Building a Rugby Union Accumulator from Our Tips

An accumulator (or acca) combines several selections into one bet, but every leg has to win for it to pay out, so OLBG's tipsters typically back win singles instead.

If you would still like a fun bet, you could build a Rugby Union acca from several teams to win in the tips on this page.

To make this easy, click Add next to the tips on this page and the selections go into your betslip. You can also add Rugby League tips or tips from other sports before you finalise your acca.

Before you place your bet, compare odds from a range of UK-licensed bookmakers. Our guide to Rugby betting sites is a good place to start. Then choose your bookmaker from the betslip, and your selections carry over, so you don't need to enter them again.

Accumulators carry more risk than single bets, so please gamble responsibly and only bet what you can afford to lose. You must be 18 or over to bet, and support is available from GamCare and BeGambleAware.

Stats cover regular-season matches from the last five completed seasons: Premiership, Top 14 and URC from 2021-22 to 2025-26, and Super Rugby Pacific from 2022 to 2026. Results use the score after 80 minutes, so Super Rugby matches settled in extra time count as level. Matches with no clear favourite are left out of the favourite and price-band figures. Club numbers changed during the period, so seasons are not like-for-like: the Premiership had 13 clubs in 2021-22 and 2022-23 (with only the matches played before Wasps and Worcester Warriors were removed from the league included) and 10 from 2023-24, while Super Rugby had 12 teams until 2024 and 11 from 2025. Rugby Union Content: Meet the Author and Editor

The Rugby Union content on this page, including our previews and betting guides, is written by Luke Bradshaw Lee and edited by Darren Brett. The tips themselves come from OLBG's tipsters.

About the author

Luke Bradshaw Lee writes OLBG's Rugby Union and Rugby League content, including the preview and betting guides for the main competitions. He has more than a decade of experience writing about sports betting, having led betting content at Covers, and his work has appeared in The Independent and The Guardian.

FAQ

Rugby Union Betting Tips FAQ

  • Yes. You can view all of the Rugby Union tips and predictions on this page for free, covering today's and upcoming matches. You must be 18 or over to place a bet.

  • Our tipsters post match-winner and handicap selections for individual matches, along with ante-post tips on tournament winners, such as the Six Nations. Each tip shows the market, the selection and the tipster's comments, so you can see the reasoning behind it.

  • A handicap gives one team a points head start to even up the contest. For example, a team tipped at +10.5 wins the bet if it wins the match or loses by 10 points or fewer. A team tipped at -8.5 has to win by 9 points or more. The half point means the bet can't be settled as a push.

  • Across the Premiership, Top 14, Super Rugby Pacific and United Rugby Championship, the pre-match favourite won between 72.9% and 75.8% of regular-season matches over the last five completed seasons. Underdogs won most of the rest, and around 2% of matches were level after 80 minutes. See our Rugby Union betting stats for the full comparison, including how favourites perform by price band. These figures come from OLBG's own database of results and historical match odds.

  • For recent matches, yes. Use the Show Expired Events button above the tips table to see tips for matches played in the last 24 hours. For older tips, each tipster's profile lists the tips they have made over the last 35 days.

  • It depends on the bookmaker's rules, so always check the terms before you bet. Match winner bets are often settled on the result after 80 minutes, which means a draw loses a bet on either team. Draws are rare, at around 2% to 2.6% of regular-season matches in the Premiership, Top 14, Super Rugby Pacific and URC, but some competitions, including Super Rugby Pacific, use extra time in certain matches.
